purpose: Distinguish Zen free-tier 429 FreeUsageLimitError as free_tier_limit and route the Go probe through the shared Go header pair.
riskRationale: Tiny, fail-open, credential-blind change: new 429 sub-branch preserves configured=true/usable=false and falls back to rate_limited; existing probe tests still pass.

text: Focused, well-scoped fix: 429 classification gains a FreeUsageLimitError branch with fail-open semantics, isConfigured() allowlists the new state, and the Go probe reuses GoRequestHeaders::for_go(). Existing tests pass and no credential-boundary rules are violated. Missing test coverage for the new branch and a stale state enum in docs are the only notable gaps.

reasoning: Correct and safe, but the new free_tier_limit branch ships without any unit coverage and docs still enumerate the old state set; adding the small matrix cases is trivial and should precede merge.

message: Reuses the existing credential-blind error.type-only pattern from the 401 CreditsError branch; no body, message, or option reads introduced.
New free_tier_limit state stays fail-open (connected=true), matching the AGENTS.md 429 must-not-lock-out contract.
Go probe reuses the shared GoRequestHeaders::for_go() pair under a class_exists guard with SessionHeader fallback; Zen path and probe model unchanged, no opencode UA spoofing.

New free_tier_limit branch has no unit coverage: neither ConnectionDiagnosticsTest nor ProbeSemanticsTest exercises a 429 FreeUsageLimitError payload, so a regression (e.g. typo in the type string) would go undetected.
suggestion: Add a classify case asserting 429 + FreeUsageLimitError yields state free_tier_limit with configured=true/usable=false, plus a plain-429 still yields rate_limited; add a probe-matrix row asserting FreeUsageLimitError stays connected.

message: Availability state enum does not list the new free_tier_limit state, so docs drift from code on merge.
suggestion: Add free_tier_limit to the documented state union in BOUNDARIES.md.
suggestionCode:
state: not_configured | verified | invalid_key | no_credits |
       rate_limited | free_tier_limit | network_error | server_error |

message: 'Accurate status copy' claim is latent: Settings.php renders only boolean connected/not connected, and no in-repo consumer branches on diagnose()['state'] == free_tier_limit, so users see no new copy yet.
suggestion: Either scope the PR description to the diagnose() contract or surface the new state in Settings/admin copy in a follow-up.
